meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 这个技能把 Emacs 接入 NanoClaw 的对话通道。装好后你可以在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲区直接向 AI 提问，AI 的回答会显示在缓冲区；你还可以选中 org 文件里的内容发送，AI 的回复会作为子标题插入到原文中。
howto.when: 当你按下聊天快捷键（如 C-c n c）打开对话缓冲区，或使用 org 发送命令（如 C-c n o）把光标所在标题或选中区域发给 AI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这段代码为什么报错？
say.note: 回答会显示在聊天缓冲区。

say.text: 把这条议程事项整理成行动列表。
say.note: 回复会作为子标题插入 org 文件。
在聊天缓冲区里得到改写版本。

howto.what_en: This skill adds Emacs as a channel to NanoClaw. After setup, you can open a chat buffer inside Emacs and ask the AI questions; replies appear in the buffer. You can also send a region or heading from an org file, and the AI's response is inserted as a child heading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer via a keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) or use the org send command (e.g. C-c n o) on a selected region/heading.

say_en.text: Explain why this function throws an error.
say_en.note: Reply shows in the chat buffer.

say_en.text: Turn this agenda item into an action list.
say_en.note: Reply is inserted as a child heading.
You get a revised version in the chat buffer.
